regression_checks: v5 x1 preserved all five sibling lanes through watcher/notifier supervision and a single cadence-gated harvest.

The x2 build should strengthen watcher-trust discipline: no manual sibling polling before cadence gates unless a notifier reports a hard blocker.
CLI bridge repair should remain fallback-only after alias proof, quality gate, and marker review checks.
Notify-prefix app completion remains the authoritative app-lane gate while probe-prefix noise remains a stale-flow watch item.
Status receipts must exclude raw lane text, stderr content, events JSONL, temp paths, screenshots, credentials, and session streams.
